spread.title: A place to look. A pattern to find.
spread.description: The opening two puzzles show how shaded cells give you a useful starting point.
spread.caption: Print edition / Pages 2 and 3

pages.label: Page 2: Puzzle 1: X-Wing
pages.alt: Start Here: Hard Sudoku with Visual Hints, printed page 2: Puzzle 1: X-Wing. Read the sample description below for context.

pages.label: Page 3: Puzzle 2: Naked Triple
pages.alt: Start Here: Hard Sudoku with Visual Hints, printed page 3: Puzzle 2: Naked Triple. Read the sample description below for context.

explanation: In Part I, all the cells of the first useful pattern are shaded. Work through the opening singles, add your candidate notes, and see what connects the shaded cells.
The first puzzle introduces an X-Wing; the second introduces a Naked Triple. Use the pattern, keep solving, and look for another chance to use the same technique without the visual hint.
